remarks: Rare opportunity to own a prime building lot in the heart of Buffalo's rapidly growing "Chandlerville" district! Located along the vibrant Chandler Street corridor, this property is surrounded by some of the city's most exciting destinations, including Chandler Street Breweries, home to Community Beer Works, Chandler Street Breweries, and Smoldered Society, as well as Buffalo Barrel + Brine and the acclaimed Waxlight Bar A Vin. The area has become a hub for breweries, dining, art, and creative businesses, attracting visitors and investment from across Western New York. Conveniently situated near Hertel Avenue, Elmwood Village, Delaware Park, and downtown Buffalo, this parcel offers exceptional potential for residential or mixed-use development (subject to approvals). Take advantage of the momentum in one of Buffalo's most talked-about redevelopment corridors and bring your vision to life. Join the transformation of Buffalo's Black Rock neighborhood, where former industrial spaces have been reimagined into a thriving destination for food, craft beverages, entertainment, and entrepreneurship.
facts: City Lot, Rectangular, Rectangular Lot, Cleared
